commits.subject: fix(scheduler): eve-of-break wakeup — never idle on a past next_wakeup
commits.body:
2026-07-12 incident: the last games-day before the All-Star break completed
at 18:36 ET; step 7's raw compute_wakeup_time(fetch_schedule(tomorrow))
returned TODAY 10:00 for the empty tomorrow, _idle_until_next_wakeup
silently no-opped on the past time, run_day returned, and Restart=always
relaunched every ~48s (NRestarts 3→50, one health DM per cycle).

- step 7 now uses _next_day_wakeup (audit E1 — built for exactly this,
  but only wired into the no-games-today path until now)
- _next_day_wakeup: day-bump reserved for EMPTY tomorrows; a nonempty
  tomorrow whose wake has passed hands off in ~1min (bumping a day would
  sleep through a real early slate — post-midnight EOD before London
  06:10 ET; review r2#1); fetch/compute failure hands off on a 15-min
  retry instead of guessing a safe morning (r2#2); computation shares the
  fetch's exception boundary (r3 — a malformed gameDate in a successful
  response must not raise into a bare churn loop)
- compute_wakeup_time gains now_et (caller's clock) so the empty branch
  is testable and consistent with the bump comparison
- _idle_until_next_wakeup no-ops stay (substituting a guessed wake could
  sleep through a REAL game day) but are now loud
- fetch_schedule + predict._fetch_game_slots filter to regular-season
  games via shared util.is_regular_season_game — the 7/14 All-Star Game
  is not a pickable slate, and the preview cron fetches independently
  (r2#3)
- 'Tomorrow's wake-up' log now prints the date; the time-only format hid
  the wrong-day wakeup all through the incident journal

commits.subject: fix(health): dedup health DMs per day + unblind restart_spike
commits.body:
The 7/12 loop sent 47 identical CRITICAL DMs because the dispatcher is
designed to run once per day and sends unconditionally, and restart_spike
advanced its checkpoint every run — 48s re-walks moved the baseline +1 at
a time, so the storm never summed past the +3 threshold (aliasing).

- dispatch_dm_for_health_alerts: per-day (level, incident-identity)-set
  dedup persisted in health_dm_delivery_status.json. Keyed on identity,
  not body hash (a growing delta is the same problem); a NEW source
  same-day still sends; failed sends are never suppressed (H6 resurface
  intact); keyed to the PROCESSED day via runner now_et_date=today so a
  post-midnight EOD for D doesn't consume D+1's budget (r2#5)
- Alert gains optional incident_key (r2#6): two DIFFERENT crashed checks
  both carry source=health_runner and the second must still reach the
  operator; _safe_run sets health_runner:{check}; attention._with_streak
  preserves it through reconstruction (r3)
- restart_spike: checkpoint anchors to the processed date and advances
  only across a date boundary; multi-day gaps budget one planned
  exit-restart per elapsed day beyond the first (threshold base+(gap-1)
  keeps the UNPLANNED bar constant at base-1 — the daily idle→return→
  Restart=always exit is planned, and no-games days never run health, so
  the 4-day break would have read as a +4 false spike on 7/16) (r2#4)

commits.subject: fix(health): predicted_vs_realized grades per slot; recalibrate CRITICAL
commits.body:
The 7/12 CRITICAL compared the PRIMARY's p_game_hit against the DAY-level
result — on double-down days the day result requires BOTH legs, so the
MDP's DD-dense streak-0 rebuild mechanically inflated the gap. Live
decomposition: day-level drift +0.1737 'CRITICAL' vs primary-only +0.042;
the real signal was the DD leg going 1-for-6 (~0.56% if calibrated).

- per-slot grading via slot_results (primary + DD leg each against its
  own p) — the attribution realized_calibration adopted 2026-05-01 for
  this exact bias; validated against the live pick data: drift +0.1276
- legacy files: single-pick day result kept (it IS the primary outcome);
  legacy DD days excluded symmetrically — keeping attributable hits
  while dropping unattributable misses is outcome-dependent censoring
  that can MASK degradation (r2#7)
- drift_critical 0.12 → 0.25: the overlapping 14d/28d drift SE is ≈0.094
  at day level, so 0.12 was ~1.3σ (r2#9); WARN 0.08 stays the attention
  signal; day-block bootstrap recalibration queued
- incident audit doc (3 review rounds) + ARCHITECTURE health-table row +
  CLAUDE.md suite count 1839
